title: Sources, schema v0
description: Every source a value in data/models may cite, with its licence.

kind.description: 'dataset': a published data file. 'provider_page': a provider's own page, such as a price list or a model card. 'measurement': our own measurement, with its method. 'file_listing': file sizes read from a repository host.

revision.description: The exact version read, such as a commit.

licence.description: An SPDX identifier, or 'facts' for single facts read from a public page (a price, a file size, a parameter count), where we copy no text or tables.

attribution.description: The credit to give when you reuse these values.

method.description: For a measurement: the file in this repository that describes how it was done.
